description: Fetch entities and non-entity objects by handle, in the order asked for. Full properties include owners, extension dictionaries, references and collections where decoded, including read-only BLOCK/ENDBLK/SEQEND markers, symbol-table controls and SORTENTSTABLE. Opaque control tails are returned with partial status. decodeStatus distinguishes full, partial and unsupported bodies. Handles that are not in the drawing come back under `missing` rather than being dropped.

properties.description: "summary" (default), "full", or an array of property names.

name: cad.get_objects
